front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏     系列 《41》

en: Late autumn, within the slanting sun
Wild chrysanthemums
Silent, silent
At midnight, as if a fishing boat sings at dusk
That is the man of Wuling returning, telling his tale
Peach Blossom Spring still scatters its fallen petals

points.zh:
晉太元中，武陵人捕魚爲業。緣溪行，忘路之遠近。忽逢桃花林，夾岸數百步，中無雜樹，芳草鮮美，落英繽紛，漁人甚異之。復前行，欲窮其林。林盡水源，便得一山，山有小口，彷彿若有光。便舍船，從口入。初極狹，才通人。復行數十步，豁然開朗。土地平曠，屋舍儼然，有良田美池桑竹之屬。阡陌交通，雞犬相聞。其中往來種作，男女衣着，悉如外人。黃髮垂髫，並怡然自樂。  既出，得其船，便扶向路，處處志之。及郡下，詣太守，說如此。太守即遣人隨其往，尋向所志，遂迷，不復得路。
--東晉 。陶淵明《桃花源記》
points.en:
During the Taiyuan era of the Jin dynasty, a man of Wuling made his living by fishing. Following a stream, he lost track of how far he had gone, when suddenly he came upon a grove of peach blossoms. For several hundred paces along both banks there were no other trees; the fragrant grass was fresh and beautiful, and fallen petals lay scattered about. The fisherman found this very strange, and went further, wishing to see the end of the grove. The grove ended where the stream began, and there he came upon a mountain with a small opening, through which a faint light seemed to shine. He left his boat and entered through the opening. At first it was very narrow, barely wide enough for a person to pass; after walking a few dozen more paces, it suddenly opened out into broad light. The land was level and open, the houses neat and orderly, with fine fields, beautiful ponds, and groves of mulberry and bamboo. Paths crossed in all directions, and the sounds of chickens and dogs could be heard from one another. The people coming and going, tilling the fields, men and women in their clothing, all appeared just like people from outside. The elderly with yellow hair and the children with hair in tufts were all joyful and content. Once the fisherman came out, he found his boat and retraced the way he had come, marking it at every point. On reaching the prefectural town, he went to see the governor and told him what he had found. The governor sent men to follow him and search for the marks he had left, but they became lost and never found the way again.
-- Eastern Jin. Tao Yuanming, 'Record of the Peach Blossom Spring'

en: Following the sinking, setting sun
I, and the drifting clouds
All has grown quiet

points.zh:
Yosemite National Park (中文譯爲優勝美地國家公園) 成立於1890年。主要景點有: Yosemite Valley, Tunnel View, El Capitan, Sentinel and Half Domes, Yosemite Falls, Bridal Veil Fall, Giant Sequoia Tree Groves. “It is by far the grandest of all the special temples of Nature I was permitted to enter.”          ---  John Muir
Ansel Adams ( 1902~1984 ) 生於美國舊金山，是傑出的風景攝影家，攝影教育家和寫作家，自然環境保護者，「區域曝光理論」的創始者。他以拍攝黑白風景作品見長，以Yosemite National Park系列最著名。一生致力以攝影技藝顯示大自然壯觀之美，「完全擯棄攝影的記錄功能，使攝影成爲純粹的技術運作，爲美感的表達工具」。亞當斯用「純粹」的攝影藝術去表現真實美麗的世界，喚起攝影家對純粹攝影藝術表現特性和無限潛力的注意。亞當斯認為，攝影家正如其它藝術家一樣，選擇屬於自己獨特性的事物和領域，去表現世界和自己。在他六十多年的攝影創作生涯中，一直以風景攝影作品馳名世界。作品以精湛完美的攝影形式，展現動人景觀，以個人觀念詮釋大自然，使人們意識到自然環境保護的重要性。1980年獲得美國「總統自由徽章」。
“At one with the power of the American landscape, and renowned for the patient skill and timeless beauty of his work, photographer Ansel Adams has been a visionary in his efforts to preserve this country’s wild and scenic areas, both on film and on Earth. Drawn to the beauty of nature’s monuments, he is regarded by environmentalists as a monument himself, and by photographers as a national institution. It is through his foresight and fortitude that so much of America has been saved for future Americans.”      President James E. Carter, presenting Ansel Adams with the Presidential Medal of Freedom.  1980
points.en:
Yosemite National Park (translated into Chinese as 優勝美地國家公園) was established in 1890. Its main attractions include: Yosemite Valley, Tunnel View, El Capitan, Sentinel and Half Domes, Yosemite Falls, Bridal Veil Fall, and the Giant Sequoia Tree Groves. "It is by far the grandest of all the special temples of Nature I was permitted to enter."          ---  John Muir
Ansel Adams (1902-1984) was born in San Francisco, USA. He was an outstanding landscape photographer, photography educator and writer, a conservationist, and the originator of the "Zone System" of exposure. He was renowned for his black-and-white landscape works, most famously his series on Yosemite National Park. Throughout his life he was devoted to using photographic craft to reveal the magnificent beauty of nature, "completely abandoning photography's documentary function, making photography a purely technical operation and a tool for the expression of beauty." Adams used "pure" photographic art to portray the real and beautiful world, awakening photographers' attention to the expressive qualities and boundless potential of pure photographic art. Adams believed that photographers, like other artists, choose subjects and fields uniquely their own through which to express the world and themselves. Over more than sixty years of photographic creation, he remained renowned worldwide for his landscape photography. His works, through masterful and flawless photographic form, presented moving scenery, interpreting nature through his personal vision, and made people aware of the importance of protecting the natural environment. In 1980 he received the United States "Presidential Medal of Freedom."
"At one with the power of the American landscape, and renowned for the patient skill and timeless beauty of his work, photographer Ansel Adams has been a visionary in his efforts to preserve this country's wild and scenic areas, both on film and on Earth. Drawn to the beauty of nature's monuments, he is regarded by environmentalists as a monument himself, and by photographers as a national institution. It is through his foresight and fortitude that so much of America has been saved for future Americans."      President James E. Carter, presenting Ansel Adams with the Presidential Medal of Freedom.  1980

points.zh: 黑色是「火所熏之色也」。從現代光譜學的色彩理論來看，黑色是由於光線照射在物體上時，所有的光線都被物體吸收而產生的。它是一切有彩色的終點。白色是「西方色也，陰用事。物色白」。它是由於物體沒有吸收任何光線，而是將所有光線都全部反射進了我們的眼中所產生的結果。所以它是光譜中全部色彩的總和，是萬色之源。黑、白兩色是色彩的兩個極端，白色表現為光存在的極致，它釋放一切色彩；黑色則表現為光消失的極致，它吞沒一切色彩。所有作用於視覺的色彩都始于白色而止于黑色。在現代色彩學中，黑、白色彩都是沒有色相和純度的，只有明度的差別。儘管如此，它們所呈現出來的表情卻毫不遜色於其他有彩色系，一樣是變化豐富、姿態萬千。   （ 每日頭條：2017-01-07 ）
points.en: Black is "the color produced by smoke from fire." From the perspective of modern spectral color theory, black results when light striking an object is entirely absorbed by that object — it is the terminus of all chromatic colors. White is "the color of the West, associated with yin." It results when an object absorbs none of the light striking it, instead reflecting all of it back to our eyes — it is thus the sum of all colors in the spectrum, the source of all colors. Black and white are the two extremes of color: white represents the extreme presence of light, releasing every color; black represents the extreme absence of light, swallowing every color. All color perceived by the eye begins at white and ends at black. In modern color theory, both black and white lack hue and saturation, differing only in brightness. Even so, the expressive richness they convey is in no way inferior to the chromatic colors — equally full of variation and countless forms. (Daily Headlines: January 7, 2017)

en: The pond lies quiet, its reflection
Willow branches sway gently, half hidden, half revealed
The dragonfly skims the water, a languid summer day
A photograph, a memory
A short message, a trace of feeling
A cellphone from the golden years gone by
In dreams
Flowering trees stand lush and scattered
Waking, snow drifting over the earth
Rice ears hang heavy
The farmer gathers up the dusk
Returning home with the mountain moon

points.zh:
暮從碧山下，山月隨人歸。
卻顧所來徑，蒼蒼橫翠微。
相攜及田家，童稚開荊扉。
綠竹入幽徑，青蘿拂行衣。
歡言得所憩，美酒聊共揮。
長歌吟松風，曲盡河星稀。
我醉君復樂，陶然共忘機。
--唐。李白《下終南山過斛斯山人宿置酒》
points.en:
At dusk I come down from the green mountain, the mountain moon following me home.
Looking back at the path I came by, all is a blue-green haze across the kingfisher slopes.
Hand in hand we reach a farmhouse; a child opens the bramble gate.
Green bamboo lines the secluded path; blue creepers brush against my traveling clothes.
Happily we find a place to rest, sharing fine wine together.
We sing long songs in the pine wind, until the song ends and the river stars grow sparse.
I am drunk and you are merry still; blissfully together we forget all worldly scheming.
-- Tang dynasty. Li Bai, 'Coming Down from Zhongnan Mountain, Stopping at Hermit Hu Si's Home, Where Wine Was Set Out'

en: Starlight fades away, the moon like a hook
Some stand alone beyond wind and cloud
Forgetting each other in the rivers and lakes
The evening wind blows through the woods
Tree rings spiral, turning out that year
A mood of red leaves scattering in flight

points.zh:
《 Try to Remember 》
Music: Harvey Schmidt    Lyrics: Tom Jones
Try to remember the kind of September
When life was slow and oh, so mellow.
Try to remember the kind of September
When grass was green and grain was yellow.
Try to remember the kind of September
When you were a tender and callow fellow.
Try to remember and if you remember
then follow, follow
Try to remember when life was so tender
When no one wept except the willow.
Try to remember when life was so tender
When dreams were kept beside your pillow.
Try to remember when life was so tender
When love was an ember about to billow.
